item.title: Toyota RAV4 vs Ford Kuga in Europe: The Cost of Opportunity Most Buyers Ignore
item.description:
🚗 Toyota RAV4 vs Ford Kuga (Personal Use in Europe)

Most people compare cars based on:

  • fuel consumption
  • reliability
  • comfort
  • resale value

But very few consider something more important:

The opportunity cost of the capital tied up in the purchase price.
